[NRTM.9.1] **Realtime is not in this edition, and none of its entry points is
declared.** `ds_engine_go_live` ([NRTM.5.2]),
`ds_engine_get_rt_config_binding` ([NRTM.6.1]), `ds_contract_dump_canonical`
([NRTM.6.3]), the pool-sizing setters ([NRTM.2.1], [NRTM.2.2]) and the
working-memory bound ([NRTM.2.3], [NRTM.5.4]) return with realtime, as those
deferred clauses describe them.
